entry.title: South Korea vows to prosecute students using AI glasses in exams
entry.summary:
Ma'aikatar Ilimi ta Koriya ta Kudu ta ce daga shekara mai zuwa, za ta ɗauki yin zamba a jarabawar shiga jami'a ta ƙasa da tabarau na AI a matsayin laifi na aikata laifi, bayan an kama ɗalibai uku suna sanye da irin waɗannan kayan a lokacin jarabawar rubutu a jami'o'in Seoul. Daga 2027, waɗanda aka kama za su fuskanci hani na shekaru uku daga jarabawar, maimakon shekara guda a yanzu, kuma za a sanya masu sa ido a dukkan cibiyoyin jarabawa 1,312 don duba tabarau masu shakku.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Alama bayyananne ce ta yadda kayan aikin AI mai samar da abun ciki suke wuce gona da iri kan ƙa'idojin gaskiyar jarabawa a duniya (Ginshiƙi na 1), da kuma tunatarwa cewa gano laifi da hukunci kaɗai ba su wadatar ba ga abin da jami'o'i da tsare-tsare za su buƙaci.

Times Higher Education · Established press

entry.title: AI Article Reviews Dominate Human Peer Reviews at Their Best: Evidence and Policy Choices
entry.summary:
Gary King da Steven Worthington na Institute for Quantitative Social Science ta Harvard sun kwatanta nazarin takardun bincike da AI ta rubuta da nazarin mutane 134 na takardu 124 da aka tara tsakanin 2019 zuwa 2026. Sun bayar da rahoton cewa nazarin da Claude Opus 4.8 ta samar sun fi nazarin mutane a kowace ma'auni da suka gina, an tantance su a matsayin daidai sosai a binciken nasu, kuma manyan editoci uku na tsohuwar mujallu sun fi son su a yawancin kwatancen kai tsaye.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan ƙalubale ne mai natsuwa, bisa bayanai, game da yadda ake amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki a aikin ilimi, ba a ɗakin karatu kaɗai ba (Ginshiƙi na 1): idan AI za ta iya nazarin bincike da kyau, jami'o'i da mujallu suna buƙatar manufa kan lokacin da yadda za a yi amfani da ita, ba kawai ko za a haramta ta ba.

Institute for Quantitative Social Science, Harvard University · University working paper

entry.title: Proposal 14: Student outcomes indicators
entry.summary:
Hukumar kula da ilimin manyan makarantu ta Ingila, Office for Students, ta gabatar da shawarar maye gurbin ma'auni guda na ci gaba na ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu da jerin alamomi uku da za a kwatanta a tsarin Teaching Excellence Framework nasu: ci gaba zuwa aiki ko ƴin karatu, albashin waɗanda suka kammala idan an kwatanta da ma'aunin ƙasa, da kuma ko waɗanda suka kammala sun ce suna amfani da abin da suka koya, bisa binciken Graduate Outcomes. Za a daidaita waɗannan ma'aunin bisa fannin karatu, wuri, cancantar shiga, da kuma yanayin tattalin arziki na ɗalibai, maimakon yin amfani da ma'auni guda na ƙasa a kan dukkan darussa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan gwaji ne na ainihi ga babban tambayar Ginshiƙi na 5: ko tsarin bayanai da aka gina daga alamomi masu yawa da za a kwatanta, maimakon ma'auni guda na ƙasa, zai iya yin shari'a da kyau kuma ya inganta sakamakon manyan makarantu.

Office for Students (OfS) · National regulator consultation

entry.title: UCT engineering pairs AI-enabled early warning with a multilingual support hub to lift student success
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Faculty of Engineering and the Built Environment na University of Cape Town sun bayyana Student Success Project wanda ya haɗa tsarin tantance haɗari tun da wuri, jagorancin ɗalibai ga junansu, da wurin taimako mai amfani da bayanai da AI. An haɗa wurin taimakon da ƙamus na dijital na harsuna da dama cikin isiXhosa, Sesotho, Kiswahili da Afrikaans, domin magance keɓancewar harshe tare da haɗarin ilimi. Babin ya bayyana a cikin Constellations of Hope, rahoton Club of Rome kan koyo mai canza rayuwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Misali bayyananne kuma da aka tabbatar daga Afirka ta Kudu na nazarin bayanai na hasashe domin samun nasarar ɗalibai (ginshiƙi na 2) wanda aka gina a kan adalci na harsuna da dama, yana nuna cewa bayanan gargaɗi da wuri suna taimakon ɗalibai ne kawai idan taimakon da ke biye da su ma yana magana da harshensu.

Globethics Publications (Club of Rome report) · Peer-reviewed book chapter

entry.title: AI literacy alone does not create graduate opportunity, Nigerian study of 450 students finds; technology readiness is what matters
entry.summary:
Binciken da aka yi wa ɗalibai 450 na jami'o'in Nijeriya ya nuna cewa ilimin kasuwanci da sanin AI duka suna ƙara shirin fasaha na ɗalibai, kuma wannan shiri ne ke tantance ko za su mayar da kayan aikin AI zuwa ƙananan kasuwanci na gaskiya. Ƙarancin albarkatu, kamar yadda ɗalibai suke ganinsa, yana raunana ayyukan kasuwanci na ɗalibai kai tsaye, amma yana ƙarfafa alaƙar da ke tsakanin shiri da aiki idan ɗalibai suna da kayan aikin.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Hujja kai tsaye don ginshiƙi na 4: samun AI shi kaɗai ba ya samar wa ɗaliban da suka kammala dama a wuraren da albarkatu ba su yawaita; gina ƙwarewa da shirin fasaha ne ke mayar da saninsu da AI zuwa hanyar rayuwa.

Journal of Entrepreneurship in Emerging Economies · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Computational text indicators fail to improve, and can worsen, predictions of academic results, Salvadoran study warns
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Universidad Salvadoreña Alberto Masferrer sun gwada ko alamomin rubutu da aka samo ta koyon na'ura game da ƙa'idojin ilimin ɗalibai za su iya inganta hasashen sakamakon ilimi fiye da bayanan gida da albarkatu masu sauƙi. A cikin ɗalibai 263 da aka kalli su a zagaye biyu a wurare biyar, alamomin ƴan kwamfuta ba su ƙara wata amfani ta hasashe mai inganci ba, kuma wani sigar ya mayar da hasashen ya ɓata sosai bayan an gyara don kwatance da yawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Gargaɗi bayyananne ga ginshiƙi na 5: bai kamata a ɗauki alamomin rubutu ko halaye da AI ta samar a matsayin abin dogaro ga shawarwarin ilimi masu girman haɗari ba tare da tabbatarwa mai tsauri ba, horo da Wits AHEAD take bi a cikin aikinta na nazarin bayanai.

Journal of Applied Research in Higher Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: LMS activity, pacing and attendance are the strongest predictors of retention in blended courses, Turkish study finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike a Journal of Higher Education Policy and Management, wanda İrfan Ayhan na Jami'ar Kırşehir Ahi Evran da ke Türkiye ya yi, ya duba yadda nazarin hasashe, wanda aka samo daga ayyukan tsarin gudanar da koyo, gudu, halayen tantancewa da halartar aji, zai iya nuna ɗalibai masu fuskantar haɗari a cikin darussan manyan makarantu masu haɗaka. Ya gano cewa waɗannan alamomin su ne mafiya ƙarfi wajen hasashen riƙe ɗalibai, kuma ya yi jayayya cewa, idan an yi amfani da shi yadda ya kamata, nazarin hasashe zai iya ƙarfafa tsarin gargaɗin da wuri da kuma jagorantar dabarun cibiyoyi, matukar cibiyoyi suma suka kula da ɗa'ar amfani da irin wannan bayanai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin hasashe don nasarar ɗalibai, binciken ya tunatar da cewa bayanan da suka riga sun kasance a tsarin gudanar da koyo na jami'o'i da yawa, ba kawai sababbin kayan aikin AI ba, na iya ƙarfafa tsarin gargaɗin da wuri mai aiki idan an haɗa shi da tsarin ɗa'a bayyananne.

Journal of Higher Education Policy and Management · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Short hands-on workshop lifts science teachers' confidence in using AI for adaptive teaching, German pilot study finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na gwaji da aka buga a mujallar Frontiers in Education, wanda Mathea Brückner, Christoph Thyssen da Johannes Huwer na jami'o'in Konstanz, Pädagogische Hochschule Thurgau da Pädagogische Hochschule Freiburg suka yi, ya duba ko gajeren taron bita mai ɗauke da ayyukan hannu zai iya ƙara wa malaman ilmin kimiyya na matakin farko na sakandare kwarin gwiwa wajen amfani da AI don koyarwa mai daidaitawa. A cikin binciken da ya shafi malamai 16 masu horar da wasu a Jamus, kafin da bayan, ra'ayin malaman game da amfanin AI da kwarin gwiwarsu na amfani da ita duka sun karu sosai bayan taron bitar, inda alakar ƙarfi tsakanin su biyu ta bayyana ne kawai bayan haka. Marubutan sun yi gargaɗi cewa ƴan tsirarun mahalarta, waɗanda suka bayar da ra'ayinsu da kansu, ya nuna canji, ba hujjar cewa taron bitar ne ya haifar da ci gaba mai dorewa ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙi na Wits AHEAD kan AI da bincike a ilimin STEM da horar da malamai, binciken ya kawo tsarin aiki mai sauƙi, mara tsada, gajeren taron bita mai ɗauke da ayyukan hannu, wanda shirye-shiryen horar da malamai za su iya gwada su kuma su daidaita don gina kwarin gwiwar malaman ilmin kimiyya kan kayan aikin AI.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: World Bank video: 'small AI', not big models alone, can widen opportunity in developing-economy education and jobs
entry.summary:
A taron Duniya na AI da Dijital da aka yi a birnin Seoul, wanda Kungiyar Bankin Duniya ta rubuta, Shugabanta Ajay Banga ya bude tattaunawa kan yadda kayan aiki na "AI karami", masu amfani kuma suka dace da yanayin gida, maimakon manyan tsarin gaba daya kadai, za su iya habaka dama a tattalin arzikin kasashe masu tasowa. Ministan Sadarwa, Kirkire-kirkire da Tattalin Arziki na Dijital na Najeriya, Bosun Tijani, ya hada kai da Shugaban Zartarwa na Tridge, Hoshik Shin, da wanda ya kafa Amini, Kate Kallot, don tattauna ilimi, noma da ayyukan gwamnati, tare da wani bangare kan darussan da aka samu daga amfani da AI a ilimi a El Salvador. Kwamitin ya ambaci bayanan gida masu dogara, hadin sadarwa mai rahusa, karfin kwamfuta, kwarewa da tsarin siye a matsayin sharudan da ke bada damar masu kirkire-kirkire na gida su habaka hanyoyin AI nasu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshikin Wits AHEAD kan AI, kwarewar wadanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan tattaunawa ta dora alkawarin AI a kan sharudan aiki, kwarewa, ababen more rayuwa da siye, wadanda ke yanke shawara ko jami'o'i da tsarin kasashe masu tasowa za su amfana da gaske, maimakon takwarorinsu masu albarkatu fiye da su a Arewacin Duniya kadai.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Review of generative AI ethics in higher education finds Africa only 11% of the evidence, calls for Ubuntu-informed governance
entry.summary:
Nazarin tsari da aka buga a mujallar Education Sciences, na Pearl Yarkor Yarboi da abokan aikinta a Jami'ar Ghana, ya duba bincike 246 da aka buga tsakanin 2018 zuwa 2025 kan ɗa'a na AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, kuma ya gano cewa cibiyoyin Afirka sun kai kashi 11.4 cikin ɗari kawai na wannan bincike, kuma cibiyoyin Ghana kashi 2.8 cikin ɗari kawai. Ya tattara damuwar da ake maimaitawa cikin bangarori biyar, gaskiyar ilimi, sirri da tsaron bayanai, buɗewa da lissafi, adalci da samun dama, da sanin AI, kuma ya ba da rahoton cewa musamman cibiyoyin Ghana suna da gudanarwa ta tsari kadan.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, kiran wannan nazari don tsarin ɗa'a da ya dace da yanayi kuma ya gina a kan Ubuntu, maimakon ka'idojin da aka shigo da su daga Arewacin Duniya, yana da alaka kai tsaye da yadda kungiyar take tunkarar AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantun Afirka.

Education Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review of 50 studies finds university AI governance works best when oversight, integrity rules and data risk are managed together
entry.summary:
Nazarin tsari da aka buga a mujallar Frontiers in Education, wanda Fritz D. Bacalso da abokan aikinsa a Jami'ar Fasaha ta Cebu a Philippines suka jagoranta, ya duba bayanai 221 bisa ga tsarin PRISMA 2020 kuma ya hada bincike 50 kan yadda jami'o'i ke gudanar da AI mai samar da abun ciki. Ya gano cewa karbuwa mai kyau ya dogara ne a kan balagar gudanarwa: kula wanda ya hada bangarorin jami'a, ka'idojin bayyane na gaskiyar ilimi da bayyanawa, da gudanar da bayanai bisa hadari, tare da amfanin aiki da koyo idan tallafin koyarwa ya kasance. Nazarin ya kuma nuna babban gibi tsakanin yankuna, yana ambaton bincike guda da ya nuna jami'o'i shida a Afirka ta Kudu suna da manufofin AI na yau da kullun, yayin da babu wata cibiya da aka dauko a Ghana ko Najeriya da ke da tsarin gudanarwa da jama'a za su iya ganin sa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan shaida cewa balagar gudanarwa, ba samun kayan aiki kadai ba, ita ce ke yanke sakamako, na goyon bayan ra'ayin cewa jami'o'in Afirka su gina kula da ta hadu tare, maimakon manufar da take kawai a takarda.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review proposes a two-part framework for generative AI and academic integrity in higher education
entry.summary:
Nazarin adabi na tsari da aka buga a cikin mujallar AI and Ethics, wanda Batool Hendal da Gobinda Chowdhury suka rubuta, ya bincika binciken da aka yi lamba 274 daga bincike da ke akwai kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, kuma an rarraba su cikin jigogi shida, wanda ya hada da fa'idoji da hadarinsa, rashin dogara da kayan gano rubutun AI, da manufofi da gudanarwar jami'a. Daga wannan shaida, marubutan sun gabatar da Tsarin Daidaitawa na Ilimi don AI mai samar da abun ciki, wanda ya tsaya a kan ginshiƙai biyu, gudanarwa da ababen more rayuwa a bangare daya, da ilimi da sanin AI a bangare na biyu, a matsayin hanya mai amfani don karbar AI mai samar da abun ciki cikin nauyi maimakon kawai sa ido a kai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan tsari yana ba jami'o'in Afirka madadin mai tsari maimakon sa idon da ya dogara da gano kadai, wanda an gina shi daga tarin shaida maimakon kwarewar jami'a daya.

AI and Ethics · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Mixed-methods study of 1,685 publications and 48 interviews finds generative AI is reshaping assessment, not just fuelling misconduct
entry.summary:
Bincike mai hade hanyoyi da aka buga a mujallar SN Social Sciences, na Florieza M. Mangubat da Fernando N. Mangubat, ya hada nazarin bayanan kasidu 1,685 da ke cikin Scopus kan gaskiyar ilimi da tantancewa tare da tambayoyi ga dalibai da malamai 48 a manyan makarantu a yankin Cebu, Philippines. Ya gano cewa kulawar ilimi kan batun ta karu kwarai bayan 2022, cewa dalibai suna amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki don koyo da aikin ilimi amma galibi ba su da tabbaci kan abin da ake dauka a matsayin amfani da ya dace, kuma cewa malamai suna mayar da martani ta hanyar sake tsara tantancewa zuwa ayyuka na gaskiya da suka dogara da tsari, maimakon dogara da kayan gano AI kadai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, gano cewa cibiyoyi a wani sashe na Kudancin Duniya suna matsawa daga sa ido zuwa sake tsara tantancewa yana daidai da abin da jami'o'in Afirka suke tunani a kai, kuma yana karfafa ra'ayin cewa gyara tantancewa amsa ce mai dorewa fiye da gano kadai.

SN Social Sciences · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Systematic review of 463 studies finds AI in Global South universities still mostly administrative, not pedagogical
entry.summary:
Bincike na tsari da nazarin bayanan bugu da aka buga a mujallar Frontiers in Education, na Nomfundo Gladys Khoza da Freda van der Walt na Jami'ar Fasaha ta Tsakiya, Free State, Afirka ta Kudu, ya bincika bayanai 947 kuma ya hada da bincike 463 da masana suka tantance, da aka buga tsakanin 2019 zuwa 2025, kan koyarwa da AI ke inganta a manyan makarantu a Kudancin Duniya. Ya gano cewa yawancin amfani da AI har yanzu yana nufin ingantaccen fasaha da ayyukan gudanarwa, cewa hada AI na gaske cikin koyarwa har yanzu karami ne, kuma cewa rashin isassun ababen more rayuwa, rashin daidaito a samun kayan dijital, rashin isasshen shirya malamai da damuwar da'a su ne manyan matsaloli, yayin da hanyoyin da suka dace da yanayin gida da kirkire-kirkire na hadin kai suke bayyana a matsayin dama mafiya bayyana.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a koyarwa da kan manufofin AI mai nauyi da adalci, gano cewa amfani na gudanarwa har yanzu ya fi kirkire-kirkiren koyarwa na gaske a fadin Kudancin Duniya alama ce cewa jami'o'in Afirka, har da Wits, suna bukatar saka hannun jari da gangan a shirya malamai da hanyoyin koyarwa da suka dace da yanayin gida, ba kawai samun damar kayan AI ba.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article (systematic review)

entry.title: US universities race to launch AI majors as the count passes 100, nearly double in a year
entry.summary:
Jami'o'i sama da 100 na Amurka yanzu suna bayar da digiri na farko a fannin AI a sassan kimiyyar kwamfuta, kusan ninki biyu na adadin da ake da shi shekara guda da ta gabata, a cewar bayanan da Cibiyar Inclusive Computing ta Jami'ar Northeastern ke ajiye. Digirin AI na Jami'ar Bentley ya karu daga dalibai kadan a lokacin kaddamarwa a 2024 zuwa kusan 100 a bana, yayin da digirin AI and Decision Making na MIT, wanda aka kaddamar a 2022, yanzu shi ne digiri na biyu mafi shahara a jami'ar, da daliban 354 da suka yi rajista. Shugabanni sun danganta wannan gaggawa da damuwar daliban kan kasuwar aiki da AI ta canza, da bukatar ma'aikata na wadanda suka kammala karatu da suka iya AI; binciken da aka yi a watan Mayu ya gano cewa kashi daya bisa uku kacal, da kari kadan, na cibiyoyi 66 da aka bincika da suke bayar da digirin AI ne suke bukatar darasin ɗa'a.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI, karfin daliban da suka kammala, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, girma da saurin wannan canji a Arewacin Duniya, tare da bukatar koyarwar ɗa'a da ba ta daidaita ba da ke tare da shi, alama ce da Wits AHEAD za ta iya amfani da ita don tunani kan yadda jami'o'in Afirka ya kamata su tsara irin wadannan karatun AI, cikin nauyi maimakon kawai amsawa.

WBUR · Public radio news report

entry.title: Study combines AI-TPACK and Freire's critical pedagogy to rethink AI in African STEM curricula
entry.summary:
Masu bincike biyu a Jami'ar Afirka ta Kudu (UNISA) sun gabatar da tsarin ra'ayi na shigar da AI cikin tsarin karatun STEM a fadin Afirka, ta hada tsarin AI-TPACK da hanyar koyarwa mai zurfi ta Paulo Freire. Da yin la'akari da nazarin rubuce-rubucen da suka gabata maimakon bincike na filin, takardar ta binciki kayan aiki irin su tsarin koyarwa mai hazaka, dandamali na koyo mai sake daidaitawa, da kimantawa ta atomatik, tana nuna cewa wadannan na iya rage matsin lamba a azuzuwan da suka cika kuma ba su da isassun kayan aiki. Ta ba da shawarar dabarun da suka dace da al'ada kuma suka dogara da ɗa'a, wadanda ke magance gibin kayayyakin more rayuwa, karfin malamai, da bambancin yanayi, domin karbar AI ba ta kara rashin daidaito da ke akwai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin bayanai a fannin STEM da horar da malamai, takardar na ba da tsarin nazari mai zurfi wanda ya samo asali daga Afirka, don auna alkawuran AI a koyarwar STEM da gibin kayayyakin more rayuwa da karfin malamai na nahiyar, gargaɗi wanda ya kamata ya rage gaggawar karbar AI.

Eurasia Journal of Mathematics, Science and Technology Education (University of South Africa) · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Survey finds most Built Environment students use AI chatbots but African universities still lack formal AI policy
entry.summary:
Binciken daliban Built Environment, wanda aka gabatar a Taron FIG na 2026 a Cape Town, ya gano cewa kashi 74 cikin dari sun riga sun yi amfani da na'urorin hira na AI don karatu, kuma suna da ra'ayi mai kyau game da su, amma sun ce suna samun jagora kadan daga jami'o'insu. Marubutan, wadanda suke rubutu daga Namibiya da Nijeriya, sun lura cewa jami'o'i kadan ne na Afirka ta Kudu, hada da Wits, Jami'ar Cape Town, Jami'ar Pretoria da Jami'ar Johannesburg, suka samar da ka'idojin AI tun 2024, yayin da kashi 70 cikin dari na jami'o'in Amurka suke da manufofin AI da aka rubuta. Sun gabatar da taswirar hanya domin jami'o'in Afirka su gina tsarin mulkin AI da ya dace da yanayinsu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga ginshiƙin Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗa'a, manufofi, adalci da shugabanci, gano cewa yawancin cibiyoyin Afirka har yanzu ba su da wata manufa ta AI, duk da yadda daliban ke amfani da na'urorin hira na AI a ko'ina, yana nuna yadda shugabanci ya rage baya ga aiki; taswirar hanya da takardar ta bayar na ba da wurin farawa don rufe wannan gibi.

FIG Congress 2026 (International Federation of Surveyors), Cape Town · Conference paper (International Federation of Surveyors)

entry.title: WISE and Education Collaborative partner with five African universities on an AI adoption pilot
entry.summary:
WISE (World Innovation Summit for Education) da Education Collaborative na Ashesi University sun kaddamar da aikin gwaji na amfani da AI tare da jami'o'i biyar na Afirka: Bells University of Technology a Nijeriya, Botho University a Botswana, KCA University a Kenya, University of Kigali a Ruwanda, da Université d'Abomey-Calavi a Benin. Daga Oktoba 2026 zuwa Yuni 2027, kowace jami'a za ta gwada aikinta na musamman bisa ga bukatunta, daga malamai masu amfani da AI da suka dace da tsarin karatu da kayan koyo masu dacewa, zuwa tsarin gargadi da wuri da tsarin shugabanci na cibiyoyi. Aikin gwajin ya dogara ne a kan bincike na asali na 2025 wanda ya shafi jami'o'i 47 na Afirka, wanda ya gano cewa amfani da AI bai daidaita ba, kuma shugabanci yana raunana.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Wits AHEAD kan shugabancin AI mai inganci, wannan gwaji ne na kasashe da dama da ba a saba yin irinsa ba, wanda ke gwada kayan aikin AI tare da manufofin cibiyoyi a lokaci guda a cikin jami'o'i biyar na Afirka masu bambance-bambance sosai, inda yake bayar da shaida ta farko ta kwatance kan yadda amfani mai inganci yake a zahiri.

africa.com (WISE and The Education Collaborative, Ashesi University) · International education initiative announcement

entry.title: Early success indicators at a South African university: a data-centric approach to student success
entry.summary:
Philokuhle Majozi da Kgadi Mathabathe na University of Pretoria sun gabatar da tsarin "alamomin nasara da wuri" wanda yake haɗa bayanai da matakan taimako a dukkan rayuwar ɗalibi, daga kafin rajista har zuwa jarabawar ƙarshe. Bisa tattaunawa da masu koyar da nasarar ilimi, shugabannin cibiyoyi da masana bayanai, tsarin yana fifita hanyar da ta dogara da ƙarfin ɗalibi tana aiki tun da wuri, maimakon tsarin gargaɗin da wuri mai mayar da hankali kan raunin da ake kira "cikin haɗari."

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana ba sashin nazarin bayanai na hasashe na Wits AHEAD madadin na Afirka ta Kudu wanda ya dogara da ƙarfin ɗalibi, sabanin tsarin gargaɗin da wuri na al'ada, kuma yana da amfani kai tsaye wajen tsara matakan riƙe ɗalibai da za su taimaka, ba kawai yiwa ɗalibai da suke fama da wahala alama ba.

Journal of Student Affairs in Africa · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Cambridge-led OpRaise report: AI markers favour style over substance in university essays
entry.summary:
Masu bincike daga jami'o'in Cambridge, Manchester Metropolitan da Nottingham sun gwada manyan tsarin AI guda uku, kowanne shi kaɗai da kuma tare, a kan rubuce-rubucen ilimin halayyar ɗan'adam 761 na ɗalibai na shekarar farko daga jami'o'i uku na Birtaniya. Tsarin AI sun yi daidai sosai da juna, amma ba haka suke yi da masu duba jarabawa ɗan'adam ba, suna ba lada ga rubutu mai tsawo da sarƙaƙƙiya ko da bai cancanci darajar ilimi ba, kuma maki na taruwa a tsakiyar ma'auni.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Yayin da Wits AHEAD take auna matsayin AI wajen tantancewa, wannan bincike mai inganci daga jami'o'i daban daban ya nuna cewa tantance aiki ta atomatik har yanzu tana fifita salo a kan ma'ana, wannan gargaɗi ne kan ɗauka AI a maimakon hukuncin ɗan'adam a jami'o'in Kudancin Duniya, inda azuzuwa suka fi girma kuma masu duba jarabawa kaɗan.

University of Cambridge, Manchester Metropolitan University and the University of Nottingham (OpRaise project) · University research report

entry.title: World Bank video: Korea Partnership Facility forum explores AI for education and skills
entry.summary:
Tashar YouTube ta World Bank Group ta fitar da gajeren fim game da taron bana na Korea-World Bank Group Partnership Facility, inda jami'ai daga Ma'aikatar Tattalin Arziki da Kuɗi ta Korea, ƙwararru daga World Bank da wani farfesa daga KAIST suka tattauna yadda AI za ta iya ƙarfafa koyo da shirya mutane don ayyukan nan gaba. Facility ɗin tana ba da kuɗaɗe ga shirye-shiryen AI da ƙwarewar dijital don tsarin ilimi da ayyukan yi a ƙasashe masu tasowa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 4, wannan yana nuna cewa cibiyoyin kuɗi na duniya yanzu suna ɗaukar horon ƙwarewar AI a matsayin muhimmin abu ga samun aikin yi na ɗaliban da suka kammala karatu da sauye-sauye masu adalci, ba wani ƙari ba.

World Bank Group (YouTube) · International financial institution, official video channel

entry.title: Study finds South African universities' AI policies strong on student rules, thin on privacy and staff duties
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na inganci kan jagororin AI mai samar da abun ciki da jami'o'in gwamnati na Afirka ta Kudu suka buga ya nuna cewa kashi 46 cikin ɗari kaɗai ne na cibiyoyin suke da manufa a matakin cibiya a lokacin binciken. Inda jagororin suke, sun tsara ƙa'idoji dalla-dalla kan bayyana gaskiya da nauyin ɗalibai, amma sun yi magana kan sirri, mulkin bayanai da nauyin ma'aikata a taƙaice ne kawai, galibi a matsayin shawara ba ƙa'idojin wajibi ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 6, wannan hujja ce kai tsaye ga Wits AHEAD: marubutan sun yi kira da jagororin da suka yi daidai, wanda an tsara su tun daga farko domin kare sirri, wannan shi ne ainihin gibin gudanar da AI mai nauyi wanda ƙungiyar take bibiya.

Universal Access in the Information Society · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Smartphone AI tools help STEM teachers in low-resource African classrooms move beyond chalk and talk, study finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na shari'a wanda Universiti Sains Malaysia ta jagoranta ya yi aiki da malaman STEM goma daga Nijeriya, Botswana, Ghana, Namibiya da Saliyo a wani taron horo mai aiki da hannu wanda ya yi amfani da kayan aikin AI masu mayar da murya zuwa hoto, rubuta koda ta hanyar toshe-toshe a wayar hannu, da kwaikwayon kewayawar lantarki. Malaman sun ce kayan aikin sun sauƙaƙa nuna ra'ayoyin kimiyya masu wahala, sun ba ɗaliban da ba su da kwamfutar hannu damar gina ƙwarewar rubuta koda a wayar hannu, kuma sun ba su damar gwada kewayawar lantarki cikin aminci kafin su taɓa kayan aiki na gaske da ba su yawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga Ginshiƙi na 3, wannan hujja ce mai kyau cewa kayan aikin AI da aka zaɓa da kyau kuma masu araha, ba kayan aiki masu tsada ba, su ne za su iya canza koyar da STEM a azuzuwan Afirka marasa isassun kayan aiki daga koyarwar lacca zuwa binciken gaskiya.

ECNU Review of Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI and data, not just adopt it, UFS tells QS Africa Forum
entry.summary:
A taron QS Africa Forum na 2026 da aka yi a Addis Ababa, Farfesa Sam Tshehla, Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'ar Free State (UFS), ya shaida a zauren tattaunawa kan bủatar AI da makomar ilimi mai zurfi cewa jami'o'in Afirka dole su daina kawai mayar da martani ga AI, su gina bayanansu da tsarinsu nasu wanda ke nuna harsuna, al'adu da manufofin ci gaba na nahiyar. Ya ce AI na iya taimakawa a duk tafiyar ɗalibi, daga karɓar ɗalibai zuwa koyarwa da bincike, amma sai da an saka hannun jari a ̉ancin fasahar dijital, shugabanci da ̉ancin ɗabi'a.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 6 kan AI mai rỉon amana, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan kiran na bayanai da tsarin da Afirka take da shi na kanta ya yi daidai da yadda Wits AHEAD ke nanatawa kan tsarin shugabancin AI da ya samo asali daga yankin, maimakon na shigo da shi, a Kudancin Duniya.

University of the Free State · University report

entry.title: AI exposure linked to 13 percentage point rise in top grades, Berkeley working paper finds
entry.summary:
Takardar bincike ta Igor Chirikov ta Cibiyar Nazarin Ilimi Mai Zurfi a Jami'ar California, Berkeley, ta bincika fiye da maki 500,000 da aka bayar tsakanin 2018 zuwa 2025 a babbar jami'ar bincike. A cikin darussan da suke da ayyukan rubutu da lambar kwamfuta masu yawa, rabon maki A ya ̉ara da maki kashi 13 bayan fitowar ChatGPT, kusan kashi 30 fiye da matakin 2022, inda ̉aruwar ta fi girma a inda aikin gida ya fi tasiri a maki na ƙarshe.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya, binciken nan gargaɗi ne na cewa maki masu girma ba koyaushe suke nufin ̉arin koyo mai zurfi ba: aikin Wits AHEAD na sake fasalin tantancewa yana bukatar yin la'akari da wannan haɗarin a cikin ayyukan gida.

Center for Studies in Higher Education, UC Berkeley · Working paper, University of California, Berkeley (CSHE)

entry.title: Generative AI closes three-quarters of the productivity gap between more and less educated workers, NBER study finds
entry.summary:
Takardar bincike ta National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), wadda Guillermo Cruces, Diego Fernández Meijide, Sebastian Galiani, Ramiro H. Gálvez da María Lombardi suka rubuta, ta bayar da rahoto kan gwaji na bazuwar da aka yi wa manya 1,174 da suka gudanar da aikin warware matsalar kasuwanci. Ba tare da AI mai samar da abun ciki ba, mahalarta masu ilimin manyan makarantu sun fi masu ƙan ilimi aiki da maki 0.548 na daidaitacce; da taimakon AI, gibin ya ragu zuwa maki 0.139, wanda ya rufe kusan kashi uku cikin hudu na gibin farko. Fa'idar dai ta tsaya ne kaɗan bayan an cire kayan aikin AI don aiki na gaba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD kan ̉warewar ɗalibai masu kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, binciken nan yana da fuska biyu: AI mai samar da abun ciki na iya rage gibin ayyuka na dadadden lokaci, amma fa'idar takan ɓace idan babu ̉ỏari mai dorewa, don haka tsarin karatu na bukatar ya ci gaba da gina ̉warewar asali wadda AI kawai ke taimakawa.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Working paper, National Bureau of Economic Research

entry.title: World Bank warns AI's benefits in Africa could bypass the poorest households
entry.summary:
Rahoton Bankin Duniya, Africa Economic Update na watan Oktoba 2026, mai taken 'Building AI Readiness', ya yi hasashen cewa ci gaban tattalin arziki a Afirka ta Kudu da ke Kudu da Hamadar Sahara zai tashi daga kashi 4.1 cikin ɗari a 2025 zuwa kashi 4.3 cikin ɗari a 2026, wanda hauhawar ayyukan masu haɓaka software ke taimakawa: al'ummar masu haɓaka software ta Najeriya a GitHub ta ƴaɗu sau goma tun daga 2020, yayin da ta Ghana ta ƴaɗu kusan sau takwas. Rahoton ya ce AI za ta iya ƙara yawan aiki da samar da ayyukan yi a fadin yankin, amma ya ce yadda ake amfani da ita bai daidaita ba tukuna, kuma ya tattara a cikin tattalin arziki kalilan, musamman Kenya, Najeriya da Afirka ta Kudu. Ya ambaci wutar lantarki mai inganci, yanar gizo mai araha, ƙwarewar dijital da ƙarfin fannin gwamnati a matsayin abubuwan da har yanzu ba su samu ba a mafiya yawan sassan yankin.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai riƙon amana, adalci da manufofi, wannan rahoto gargaɗi ne mai bayyana: tsarin ilimi mai zurfi a Kudancin Duniya ba zai iya zato cewa amfanin AI zai zo da kansa ba; gina ƙarfin dijital da na cibiyoyi na asali ya kasance sharaɗin farko.

World Bank · Intergovernmental regional economic report

entry.title: Critical review finds Ghana's national AI strategy strong on readiness but thin on classroom detail
entry.summary:
Nazari mai zurfi na manufofi, da Matthew Nyaaba da sauran marubuta tara suka rubuta, ya kirkiro Tsarin Manufofin AI mai mai da hankali kan Ilimi kuma ya yi amfani da shi kan Dabarun Kasa na Hankali na Wucin Gadi na Ghana na shekarar 2025 zuwa 2035. Binciken ya ga cewa dabarun suna da buri sosai a fannin ilimin AI, kwarewar matasa da shirye-shiryen ma'aikata, amma bai bunkasa sosai ba kan 'yancin malamai, horar da malamai kafin fara aiki, jagorar manhaja da kimantawa, koyarwa mai dauke da harsuna da al'adu daban-daban, da shugabanci na hadin kai a matakin makaranta. Marubutan sun ce Ghana na bukatar tsarin aiwatarwa mai mai da hankali kan ilimi wanda ke hada manufofin ma'aikata da horar da malamai, gyaran manhaja da kare dalibai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai riƙon amana, da'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan nazari tunatarwa ce mai amfani cewa dabarun kasa na AI a Kudancin Duniya galibi suna gaba fiye da aikin matakin aji da ake bukata domin su zama na gaskiya ga malamai da dalibai.

arXiv preprint · Preprint (not yet peer-reviewed)

entry.title: US study finds no AI-driven unemployment spike yet for recent graduates
entry.summary:
Takardar bincike sabuwa daga National Bureau of Economic Research, da Robert Fairlie da Jane Wu suka wallafa, ta duba bayanan aikin yi na Amurka tsakanin Yuni zuwa Agusta 2026, domin gano ko AI mai samar da abun ciki ta fara ƙara rashin aikin yi ga sabbin ɗaliban da suka kammala jami'a. Ta hanyar kwatanta sabbin ɗaliban da suka kammala da tsofaffi da kuma matasa da ba su je jami'a ba, masu binciken ba su samu babban ƴanta a cikin rashin aikin yi da ya shafi AI a lokacin bazara 2026 ba, ko da yake wani ma'auni mai girma wanda ya hada da mutanen da suka daina neman aiki ya kara kusan kashi biyu cikin ɗari ga adadin rashin aikin yi na sabbin ɗaliban da suka kammala.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD kan ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan dubawa ta farko ce da ta dogara da bayanai kan fargabar cewa AI mai samar da abun ciki tana lalata ayyukan yi na ɗaliban da suka kammala, tunatarwa don auna zato na gida da hujja maimakon labaran ɓangare.

National Bureau of Economic Research · Economic research working paper

entry.title: Fort Hare study proposes Big Data framework to improve student retention in South Africa
entry.summary:
Bincike sabo a cikin South African Journal of Information Management, na Ganizani Mainoti da Roxanne Piderit na Jami'ar Fort Hare, ya tambayi ma'aikata talatin na ilimi a jami'o'in gwamnati hudu na Afirka ta Kudu, kuma ya duba rahotanni da manufofinsu kan riƙe ɗalibai. Ya samu tsarin bayanai da ya watse da gazawar fahimtar bayanai a tsakanin ma'aikata, kuma ya gabatar da tsarin Big Data wanda ya dogara da gudanarwar bayanai ta ɗa'a, sarrafa bayanai hade, nazarin hasashe da taimako na mutum ɗaya, domin jami'o'i su koma daga mayar da martani ga barin karatu zuwa hana shi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 2 na Wits AHEAD kan AI da nazarin hasashe domin nasarar ɗalibai, riƙe su da gargaɗi da wuri, wannan misali ne na gida, da masana suka tantance, kan abin da tsarin bayanai hade da gudanarwa suke bukata domin irin wannan nazari ya yi aiki.

University of Fort Hare, published in the South African Journal of Information Management · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: World Bank's 2026 World Development Report: AI needs reliable power, internet and skills to help developing countries
entry.summary:
Rahoton Ci Gaban Duniya na 2026 na Bankin Duniya, mai taken 'Alkawarin Hankali na Wucin Gadi', ya kafa dabarun karɓa, daidaita da ci gaba domin biliyan 5.6 na mutane da ke zama a ƙasashe masu ƴan kuɗi da matsakaicin kuɗi. Ya nuna cewa ƙasashe masu tasowa ba su bukatar gina manyan tsarin AI nasu ba, amma kawai shigo da kayan aikin AI shi kaɗai ba zai taimaka ba: AI tana aiki mafi kyau inda kayayyakin more rayuwa, kamar wutar lantarki da haɗin sadarwa, da tsarin ilimi tuni suke da amincewa, yayin da 'AI karama' da ake isar da ita ta saƙon rubutu ko wayar hannu mai sauƙi za ta iya kai wa mutane inda waɗannan basu akwai ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 6 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai ɗa'a, ɗabi'a, adalci da manufofi, gargaɗin rahoton cewa amfanin AI ya dogara da kayayyakin more rayuwa da tsarin ilimi masu amincewa, ba kawai samun fasahar ba, ya shafi kai tsaye yanayin da jami'o'i da gwamnatoci a Kudancin Duniya har yanzu suke bukatar gina.

World Bank · Intergovernmental flagship report

entry.title: UCT video: Cape Town summit brings the global debate on AI and universities to Africa
entry.summary:
A cikin wani bidiyo da aka fitar kafin taron ilimi na duniya na Times Higher Education, Jami'ar Cape Town ta sanar da cewa wannan taro, wanda aka shirya tare da Jami'ar Bristol daga ranar 29 ga Satumba zuwa 1 ga Oktoba 2026, zai kasance karo na farko da za a gudanar da shi a nahiyar Afirka, yana kawo shugabannin jami'o'i da masu tsara manufofi tare domin tattauna AI, makomar aiki, rashin daidaito da manufar jami'o'i. Shugaban jami'ar, Farfesa Mosa Moshabela, ya ce taron damar ce ga jami'o'in Afirka su taimaka wajen tsara manufar duniya, wanda ke nuna hangen nesansa na cewa Jami'ar Cape Town ta ci gaba da koyarwa, bincike da tasiri ga al'umma yayin da take karfafa kirkire-kirkire da kasuwanci ga Afirka, wanda ya ginu kan ubuntu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD kan samun ƙwarewar ɒaliban da suka kammala, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan tunasarwa ce cewa jami'o'in Afirka yanzu suna taimakawa wajen tsara, ba kawai bin ba, manufar duniya kan yadda ilimi mai zurfi ya kamata ya mayar da martani ga tasirin AI kan aiki da dama.

University of Cape Town (YouTube) · University video

entry.title: UNESCO working paper maps AI use across 200 Latin American and Caribbean universities

category.term: 19 countries, Latin America and the Caribbean

entry.summary:
Takarda sabuwar aiki daga Cibiyar Duniya ta UNESCO don Ilimi Mai Zurfi a Latin America da Caribbean (IESALC), wacce aka gudanar tare da Cibiyar Jami'ar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya don Nazarin Zurfafa kan Dorewa, ta tsara yadda AI ake amfani da shi a jami'o'i 200 na ilimi mai zurfi a kasashe 19 na Latin America da Caribbean, wanda aka yi bincikensa tsakanin Agusta zuwa Oktoba 2025. Ta duba bangarori biyar, koyarwa da koyo, bincike, hadin kai da al'umma, gudanarwa da shugabanci, domin nuna inda AI take amfani a yanzu, yadda ake sarrafa ta, karfin da cibiyoyin suke da shi da gibin da suka rage. Marubutan sun yi fatan binciken zai taimaka wa shugabannin cibiyoyi da masu tsara manufofin kasa su hada AI cikin hankali, da'a da hada kai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 5 na Wits AHEAD kan nazari da bayanai domin tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, wannan yana bayar da shaida mai wuyar samu a matakin yanki kan yadda jami'o'i suke gudanarwa da ba da kayan aiki domin amfani da AI, wani ma'auni don kwatanta da manufofin cibiyoyi na Afirka ta Kudu.

UNESCO International Institute for Higher Education in Latin America and the Caribbean (IESALC), with UNU-IAS · Intergovernmental working paper

entry.title: MIT's own AI committee calls generative AI 'not an optional exercise' for teaching
entry.summary:
Kwamitin na musamman na MIT kan yadda ake amfani da AI wajen koyarwa, koyo da horar da bincike, wanda shugabannin cibiyar suka ba wa aiki a watan Janairu 2026, ya fitar da rahoton karshe a ranar 25 ga Agusta 2026, inda ya bayyana AI mai samar da abun ciki a matsayin karfi mai 'yuwuwar ban mamaki da hadarin damuwa' wanda jami'o'i ba za su iya bi da shi a matsayin zabi na manufofi ba. Maimakon doka daya, kwamitin ya ba da shawarar cewa kowane sashe da malami su tsara nasu manufofin da suka bayyana karara kan lokacin da dalibai dole, za su iya, ko kada su yi amfani da AI, su sake tsara tantancewa da manufofin koyo dangane da hakan, kuma su ci gaba da yin nazarin hanyoyin nasu yayin da fasahar take canzawa. Shugabar Sally Kornbluth ta kira rahoton lokaci mai muhimmanci, ba kawai ga MIT ba, har da ga ilimi mai zurfi gaba daya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a ilimi mai zurfi, yadda babbar jami'ar bincike ta kai wannan matsaya ta kwamitinta na kanta na karfafa dalilin da Wits da sauran jami'o'i irinta su bi da manufofin AI a matakin kwas da sake tsara tantancewa a matsayin abu mai gaggawa, ba na zabi ba.

Massachusetts Institute of Technology · University committee report

entry.title: New dashboard design principles aim to stop learning-analytics tools overstating what they can tell teachers
entry.summary:
Masu bincike sun gabatar da TopoLA, allon nuni da ke amfani da hanyar nazarin bayanai ta topology mai suna zigzag persistent homology akan bayanan tsarin gudanar da koyo, don bin diddigin yadda ayyukan koyo na aji suke canzawa cikin lokaci. Saboda wannan hanyar nazari ba ta da ƙa'idoji tabbatattu na fassara, marubutan sun gindaya ƙa'idodi uku na tsara allon nuni irin wannan: raba ma'auni danye da fassararsa, bayyana sakamako a matakai maimakon duka a lokaci guda, da bayyana rashin tabbas na hanyar a sarari maimakon nuna tabbaci na ƙarya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 2 na Wits AHEAD kan nazarin hasashe da nazarin koyo domin nasarar ɗalibai, wannan tunasarwa ce cewa allon nuni mai kama da daidai ba dole ba ne ya zama abin dogaro, bambanci mai muhimmanci ga yadda ake tsara da bayyana kayan aikin gargaɗi da wuri da riƙe ɗalibai ga malaman da suke dogaro da su.

arXiv (preprint, accepted at IADIS International Conference Information Systems 2026) · Peer-reviewed conference paper

entry.title: Study finds six AI chatbots give African computing students patchy, often Western-centric career advice

category.term: Ten African countries (study); United States (authors, Florida International University)

entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Jami'ar Florida International sun gwada manyan tsarin AI shida, ChatGPT-4, DeepSeek, Gemini, Claude 3.5, Llama 3, da Mistral AI, kan yadda suke bayyana ayyukan farko na kwamfuta a ƙasashen Afirka goma, suna nazarin amsoshi 60 dangane da tsarin Computing Curricula 2020. Chatbot ɗin sun tattauna ƙwarewar fasaha kamar cloud computing da rubuta shirye-shirye daidai gwargwado, amma sun samu kashi 35.4 cikin ɗari kawai a matsakaici wajen fahimtar abubuwan yanki kamar tsarin fasaha, harshe, da manufofin ƙasa; tsarin AI na buɗaɗɗen tushe Llama (4.47 daga 5) da DeepSeek (4.25) sun fi kyau a nan fiye da tsarin mallaka ChatGPT-4 (3.90) da Claude (3.46), yayin da Mistral AI mai buɗaɗɗen tushe ya samu 0.00 daga 4.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 4 na Wits AHEAD kan ƙwarewar ɗaliban da suka kammala da samun aikin yi, wannan hujja ce kai-tsaye cewa shawarar sana'a ta AI, wacce ɗalibai Afirka ke ƙara amfani da ita, na iya ɗauke da zato na kai-Yamma game da ababen more rayuwa da kasuwar aiki, abin da marubutan suka ce yana buƙatar hanyoyin shawara masu la'akari da yanayin gida, masu tushen Ubuntu, kuma ɗan'adam ke jagoranta a Kudancin Duniya.

entry.title: Survey of 443 computing students finds the impostor phenomenon, not confidence, shapes how harshly they judge AI use as cheating
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya tattaro ɗalibai 443 na karatun digiri na farko a darussan kimiyyar kwamfuta na matakin farko da na tsakiya a wata jami'a ta Amurka ya neme su su kimanta tsananin yanayi 13 na zamba ta ilimi, tare da auna amincewa da kai da yanayin jin cewa mutum bai cancanci nasarorinsa ba. Ɗalibai da suka fi nuna wannan yanayin sun fi kasancewa da yuwuwar kimanta yanayin da ya shafi AI a matsayin babbar zamba, yayin da amincewa da kai da wannan yanayin kansu suke da alaka mara kyau da juna.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan hujja ce mai amfani ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki da gaskiyar tantancewa: yadda ɗalibi yake tantance amfani da AI da tsanani na iya nuna amincewar kansa da jin cewa yana cikin al'umma, fiye da aikin kansa, abin da yake da muhimmanci wajen tsara tattaunawa da manufofin gaskiyar ilimi.

entry.title: Study of 30,000 student programming submissions finds AI-code matches rising over time, but says that alone cannot prove cheating
entry.summary:
Wani bincike da ya duba ayyukan dalibai 29,970 a cikin ayyukan dakin gwaje-gwaje na Python na shekarun 2021, 2023 da 2025, aka kwatanta su da amsoshi 90,000 da manyan tsarukan harshe uku na AI suka samar, ya gano cewa lambar dalibai ta kara kamanta da amsoshin AI cikin lokaci, har da ayyukan da suka wuce dukkan jarrabawowin boye. A ayyukan da aka tsayar dasu sosai, tsarukan sun hadu ne a kan kadan daga cikin tsare-tsaren lamba daidai, yayin da ayyukan da ba a takaita su ba suka ci gaba da bambanta, a lambar dalibai da ta AI duka. Masu binciken sun kammala cewa irin wannan kamantawa yana da amfani wajen bin diddigin sauyi a dukkan aji, amma ba zai iya shi kadai ya tabbatar cewa wani dalibi guda daya ya yi amfani da AI ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki, tantancewa da gaskiyar ilimi, wannan gargadi ne akan amfani da kamantawar lamba a matsayin hujjar laifin dalibi daya, kuma alama ce ta sake tsara ayyukan tantancewa da gina ma'ajin amsoshi na tunani, maimakon dogara ga ganowa kadai.

entry.title: Wits and UJ researchers show early-warning systems for disengaged students are often tested unfairly
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Jami'ar Witwatersrand da Jami'ar Johannesburg, a cikin takarda da ba a sake duba ta ba tukuna, sun nuna cewa tsarin gargaɗin farko na ɗaliban da ke rage shiga karatu galibi ana tantance su da bayanan da a zahiri ba za su kasance a lokacin da aka yi hasashe ba, wanda ke sa tsarin ya zama kamar ya fi kyau fiye da yadda zai kasance a amfani na gaske. Ta hanyar gwada hanyoyi uku na hasashe a kan hasashe 49,329 na kowane mako daga bayanan tsarin Moodle, sun gano babu wata hanya daya da ta fi sauran a dukkan ma'auni, kuma rage matakin gargaɗi yana samun ɗalibai da yawa cikin haɗari amma yana kuma ƙara ƙararrawar ƙarya da ma'aikata dole su magance.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan yana da muhimmanci ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 2 na Wits AHEAD kan nazarin bayanai na hasashe don nasarar ɗalibai saboda yana ba jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu wata hanya mafi gaskiya ta tantancewa, kafin dogaro da tsarin gargaɗin farko, ko zai taimaka da gaske wajen gano ɗalibai da suka rage shiga karatu cikin lokaci, ba kawai yadda yake kama a baya ba.

entry.title: Generative AI access does not mean equal use, study of Chinese, Japanese and Mongolian students finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na kwatanta da aka gudanar a kan ɗaliban jami'a 42, ɗaya a kowace jami'a a China, Japan da Mongolia, ya gano cewa samun damar yin amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki kaɗai ba ya nufin zai zama da amfani daidai wa daida ga karatu. Masu bincike daga Jami'ar Osaka, Jami'ar Minnesota, Jami'ar Waseda da Jami'ar Kyoto sun bayar da rahoton cewa ɗaliban China suna sauyawa tsakanin tsarin AI na cikin gida da na duniya, ɗaliban Japan galibi suna amfani da kayan aikin duniya da harshen Jafananci, yayin da ɗaliban Mongolia sukan canza zuwa Turanci idan amsoshin harshen Mongolian suka yi kama da rauni; kungiyoyin uku duk sun auna daidaito, keɓantacce, dogaro, da tasiri a kan tunaninsu mai zurfi kafin su amince da amsa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Wannan gargaɗi ne ga aikin Ginshiƙi na 1 na Wits AHEAD kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu: harshe da yanayin fasaha na gida, ba samun dama kaɗai ba, su ne ke tantance ko AI mai samar da abun ciki na taimaka wa ɗalibai su koya da gaske, darasi da ya shafi tsarin jami'o'i masu harsuna da yawa, waɗanda ba Turanci ke mamaye su ba, a Kudancin Duniya.
